recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7207 unless a future Vocabulary or FHIR-I decision changes how LOINC publishes or identifies answer-list ValueSets.
issue_request: FHIR-7207 was a Published, Not Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Vocabulary change request objecting to ValueSet URLs for answer lists; the accepted resolution was to document how to refer to LOINC answer-list value sets.
initial_application: Jira records SVN revision 5714, matching git-svn commit 3cf763faaf84d15ea710026a46b713fbbcf1648a, which added Questionnaire source guidance saying LOINC defines useful value sets for questionnaire answers and linking to LOINC Answer Lists. The later source migration preserved that guidance in the current StructureDefinition.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini, and current Questionnaire notes explain answerValueSet, inline answerOption, contained ValueSets, and version-specific ValueSet references. The terminology page remains consistent by listing Questionnaire.item.answerValueSet as a value-set reference location. Related answer-list audits already on the combined branch support the same current behavior, while FHIR-9687 and FHIR-49027 concern separate LOINC terminology/example URL cleanups.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative source already tells implementers that LOINC answer-list ValueSets can be referenced from Questionnaire.item.answerValueSet and explains the broader answer-list modeling choices.
